captions.instagram:
Selling prints, stickers or designs you made with an AI tool? Nobody takes tax out of those sales.

✔️ The IRS says you report all income, 1099-K or not. A 1099-K only comes once payments pass $20,000 and 200 transactions.
✔️ Net earnings of $400 or more from self-employment means self-employment tax and a return to file.
✔️ Your AI tool subscription, platform fees, shipping and supplies used for the business are expenses that lower your profit.
✔️ Money arriving with nothing withheld? The last 2026 estimated payment is due January 15, 2027.

Source: IRS, Understanding your Form 1099-K; Self-employment tax.
